thesis: The phone form factor is the demo, but the per-call diff and recorded check outcome are what make this agent worth judging.
finalText: the phone part is the demo. the tool cards are the product — every call gets a diff sheet and its recorded check outcome instead of a hidden edit. strip that out and it's just another chat window in your pocket.
